scope: 51 artifacts, Original semantics and frozen outer-stock scan poses. Geometry prototype is unadopted. All four diagnostics are development evidence, not independent validation or physical-border certification.
conclusion: Art and paper boundaries, printed type, and ink-free frame texture share horizontal displacement relative to the outer stock. Neither design origin nor rarity separates all gains/losses. Cutting/centering, scan processing and print-run variation remain possible causes. Do not adopt a shared renderer shift or align to text.
next: Compare a frame-only interior pose using independent strips while retaining the existing outer-stock pose for physical borders and corners. Choose shared renderer geometry only after nuisance alignment; preserve both poses and evidence.

uncutSheetControl.description: Auction documents three 11-by-11 Revised sheets; no external sheet image copied into repository.
protocol: Prefer a flatbed scan or front-on photograph with roughly 8000 to 10000 pixels across an 11-card sheet; verify actual per-card pixel density, focus and compression.
Rectify the sheet with sheet/grid registration landmarks, controlling perspective and lens distortion. Do not independently warp cells to their text or art.
Measure art, paper, type and blank frame texture relative to the sheet grid. Compare the same cards and any duplicate sheet positions against individual Scryfall scans.
A sheet controls separate scan crops and cutting variation for that sheet; multiple sheets or runs are needed to distinguish persistent card-specific layout from run variation.

textureMethod.feature: Twice-blurred signed luminance derivatives; normalized dot correlation on interior margin 7; bilinear shifts in canonical pixels.
textureMethod.targetSelection: One calibration scan nearest the scan-only median type position, Conservator; this target choice makes the result a diagnostic, not independent alignment certification.
textureMethod.limitations: Source grain, local texture and one target may bias results. Type-line pixels diagnose co-motion only and must not define production normalization.
